description: Look up a Mantle transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in MNT, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use mantle_receipt, for emitted events mantle_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xa93012fcae16a5b4b9d6f7c7469ed2838cd27eb387b28e7334678add918d174f. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: mantle_tx
title: Mantle transaction
